name: nyxandro
description: Agent skills by nyxandro. Each skill lives and is updated in its own repository; this catalog lists them so Claude Code can install any of them as a plugin.

plugins.name: telegram-bot-development
plugins.description: Build, review and debug Telegram bots and Mini Apps against the live Bot API: the agent checks the official docs and the installed library before any call

plugins.name: t-invest
plugins.description: Gives the agent access to your T-Invest brokerage account through the T-Invest API: portfolio data, analytics and operations on your command, answered from the real account, not from memory

plugins.name: property-testing
plugins.description: Property-based tests with fast-check and Hypothesis: the strongest property, honest generators, order-of-arrival properties, failure triage

plugins.name: issue-register
plugins.description: Revise a project's register of open problems against the code: cut what is closed, keep one file, report

plugins.name: goal-rules
plugins.description: Finish a /goal task while the owner is away: no questions, recorded decisions, a hard stop-list, short commands, a written report

plugins.name: prod-recon
plugins.description: Read-only reconnaissance of prod or stage: find the way in, confirm the running commit, read logs and the database, report and stop

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Carry unfinished work from one agent session to the next with one verified document

plugins.name: sparring
plugins.description: Model-vs-model sparring for plans, reviews and second opinions, with Claude, Codex and tmux-backed CLI agents
